mika: Heads up — CI perf alarm triggered on master after yesterday's runtime merge. Decode tail p95 is ~+27% on long sequence workloads. https://ci.example/build/4823 :warning:
jordan: Which merge landed? any obvious suspects?
mika: The merger was runtime/fused-op-selector + kernel-selector tweaks (commit d4e5f6). Pasted small perf snippet below.
mika: ```
p95 decode latency (ms):
  baseline (4810): 48
  master   (4823): 61  (+27%)
flame shows extra fallback into generic attention kernel on longer seqs
```
tyler: Also seeing KV cache eviction spike ~2x since the merge. More prefix cache misses in traces.
sam: I noticed the batching heuristic change in that PR — target batch size bumped for short sequences (8 -> 12). Could change scheduling pressure.
jordan: Can we bisect? start good=0a1b2c bad=HEAD and narrow down.
mika: Started git bisect locally; initial suspect is d4e5f6 (the fused-op selector patch) — kernel selector seems to prefer a fallback attn kernel when fused ops are present.
ci-bot: [ci-perf] Perf compare: job 4823 vs baseline 4810 — decode.p95 +27% (regression) — metrics: decode.p95=61ms vs 48ms, kv.eviction_rate +2.0x
elaine: If revert confirms, we should hotfix revert to unblock canary/rollout. Can you validate revert impact quickly?
tyler: Quick local test: reverted d4e5f6 and reran micro-bench; p95 returned to ~49ms (within noise). KV eviction drops back close to baseline.
mika: Opening hotfix PR: r/PR#5123 (revert d4e5f6). Will push canary after CI.
sam: Adding temporary override to batching policy in canary to force batch_size=8 until root cause fixed.
jordan: Bisect result: culprit commit=d4e5f6. Root cause: kernel-selector heuristics compute op-flags wrong when fused-ops flag is set, causing attention to select generic fallback kernel instead of optimized fused attention.
mika: Action items: 1) merge hotfix revert PR#5123 to stop rollout 2) patch kernel-selector heuristic (owner: @jordan) 3) add CI perf guard for decode.p95 and kv.eviction delta 4) add unit test to ensure fused-op flag doesn't change kernel preference (owner: @tyler)
elaine: Blocking rollout until canary is stable and CI perf checks pass. :no_entry_sign:
mika: Thanks — I'll post status updates in this thread. Owners: @mika, @jordan, @tyler.
